metadata: Retained descriptor map; numeric fields use strict name/type/unit; state refers to matching descriptor_revision. TTL is a sample property, not metadata.
freshness: Require real source age + receiver elapsed < max_age_ms, and receiver elapsed below existing communications lease (A1 15s; frontend/M1 at most20s or configured shorter). Replayed/retained state never renews communications. Preserve counters and full snapshot invalidation.
compatibility: Additive contract documents current schema3 split metadata/state. Frozen schema2 remains unchanged. Strict older schema3 consumers may reject extended PM samples and need updating before night operation.
runtime_validation: Extended fields must bind to number and µg/m³ metadata
age_ms must be strictly below max_age_ms
All non-PM fields retain short age rules
Unknown metadata/type/unit, missing or invalid fields revoke old numeric values without losing configuration
Broker session/availability expiry is independent of source age

lan.note: No PM10 slot. Other envelope, token, identity, replay and integer-unit rules unchanged.

pm_power.interval: Local [start,end), crossing midnight allowed; equal start/end means inactive; invalid time uses dynamic measurement
pm_power.sampling: mode5 at startup and outside night; night mode1 off, 59000ms policy interval, every60th step mode5 for59000ms; first36000ms after enable cannot produce a new accepted measurement
pm_power.cache: Source timestamp only advances on an eligible complete, checksum-correct successful sample. Ordinary age limit120000; active night3600000. Module fault/TTL expiry invalidates sample.

diagnostics: Raw PM, CO2, HCHO and climate inputs remain separate from corrected business values; diagnostic registry additions are append-only. SGP baseline private cache is not transferable user configuration.
